text:
Assistant B follows the user's instructions more precisely. The user requested that each category be listed as a single topic per sentence with no extraneous words, in a line-by-line format. Assistant B provides exactly that: each line contains only the category name followed by a period, forming a complete sentence. Assistant A includes numbering (e.g., "1. Literature"), which adds extraneous words and deviates from the required format.

[[B]]
